reason: Python stdlib rendering drift: the production image runs Python 3.11.18, whose ipaddress module renders IPv4-mapped IPv6 .compressed form as dotted quad (::ffff:203.0.113.50), while these tests were written against the Python 3.9.6 host baseline rendering (::ffff:cb00:7132). Same address, different string. Fixing it would require editing tests or production source, which is out of bounds for this profile.
Same root cause as the sibling case: Python 3.11.18 renders IPv4-mapped IPv6 compressed form in dotted-quad notation, so the returned address string differs from the Python 3.9-era expectation.
